item.title: Trump Threatens 100% Tariffs on Canada Over China Ties, Warns PM Mark Carney of Severe Consequences
item.description: US President Donald Trump has warned Canada and Prime Minister Mark Carney against strengthening ties with China, threatening 100% tariffs on Canadian goods and accusing Ottawa of undermining US security and economic interests through its engagement with Beijing.

item.title: IMD issues fresh weather update as cold persists across North India; Click for details
item.description: The weather in Delhi-NCR is expected to remain clear and pleasant today, with no rainfall forecast, according to the IMD. While cold conditions persist across North India, the national capital will see light fog in the morning followed by bright sunshine during the day.

item.title: Republic Day 2026: Delhi braces for massive traffic curbs, borders to seal tonight; Full details
item.description: Delhi is set for the Republic Day Parade on January 26, with extensive traffic restrictions coming into force from the evening of January 25. Key roads in New Delhi and Central Delhi will remain closed, and city borders will be sealed from 9 PM.

item.title: Heavy snowfall cripples hill states; Over 600 roads closed in Himachal
item.description: Heavy snowfall has severely disrupted life in India’s hill states, with Himachal Pradesh and Jammu &#38; Kashmir worst affected. Over 600 roads, including national highways, remain closed due to snow accumulation. Traffic jams, stranded vehicles, and trapped tourists have added to the chaos.

item.title: Bullion Rally: Gold and Silver log massive weekly gains; Here’s how much they rose
item.description: Gold prices in India have witnessed a sharp weekly rise, with 24-carat gold gaining ₹16,480 per 10 grams, while silver surged ₹40,000 per kilogram. Strong global cues, record international prices, and expectations of US Fed rate cuts have boosted demand for safe-haven assets.

item.title: BCB breaks silence after ICC drops Bangladesh from T20 World Cup; Here’s how it happened
item.description: Bangladesh have been excluded from the T20 World Cup after refusing to play matches in India citing security concerns. The ICC rejected requests to shift games to Sri Lanka and, following multiple meetings and an ultimatum, replaced Bangladesh with Scotland.

item.title: Clash breaks out outside Swami Avimukteshwaranand’s camp in Prayagraj; Watch video
item.description: Tension prevailed outside the camp of Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati in Prayagraj after alleged unruly elements attempted to forcibly enter the premises on Sunday evening. Camp authorities claimed slogans were raised and a brief scuffle occurred with volunteers.

item.title: Bangladeshi Hindu youth burned alive in brutal garage attack; Surge in minority violence sparks concern
item.description: In a horrifying incident in Narsindi, Bangladesh, 23-year-old Hindu youth Chanchal Chandra Bhaumik was brutally killed when unknown attackers set fire in a garage where he was sleeping. CCTV footage shows the assailants pouring petrol and leaving the victim to die.

item.title: Tamil Nadu CM Stalin pays tribute to Language Martyrs; Vows ‘No Place for Hindi’
item.description: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin paid tribute to the Language Martyrs who sacrificed their lives during the anti-Hindi agitations of 1964-65. Stalin emphasized that Hindi has no place in Tamil Nadu now or ever and reaffirmed the state’s commitment to protecting Tamil language and identity.
